title: Registry Study of the University Neurovascular Network of Saarland and Rhineland-Palatinate on the Multidimensional Assessment of Clinical Course, Quality of Life, and Caregiver Burden in Patients with Stroke or Transient Ischemic Attacks
summary: This registry study aims to characterize the longitudinal clinical course of patients with stroke or transient ischemic attack and to assess the burden experienced by their informal caregivers. A multidimensional assessment with follow-up evaluations over a five-year period will be conducted. Clinical data will be extracted from routine medical records. No study-specific diagnostic or therapeutic procedures beyond standard clinical care will be performed.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Patients with a diagnosis of stroke or transient ischemic attack (TIA)
- Written informed consent provided by the patient or, where applicable, by the patient's parent(s), legal guardian, or legally authorized representative
Exclusion criteria:
Age <7 years
Patients unable to provide informed consent who do not have a legally authorized representative
